name: Stellenbosch
blurb: Stellenbosch is recognized as South Africa's primary wine-producing region, featuring historic wine routes celebrating their 55th anniversary. Visitors and researchers also note its scenic mountain setting, Cape Dutch architecture, and university town atmosphere.

positive: Celebrated for its world-class local wines and vineyards
Appreciated for its beautiful Cape Dutch architecture and scenery
Praised for wonderful hospitality and inspiring local venues
negative: Concerns over the closure of Root44 Market impacting workers
Disputes regarding local development projects and farmland
Environmental threats to iconic oak trees from borer beetles

quotes.text: TBF Stellenbosch is South Africa’s main wine-producing area.

Stellenbosch is a university town near Cape Town. Filled with beautiful Cape Dutch architecture and surrounded by impressive mountains and vineyards, it’s a gorgeous place to spend a few days in. Here’s what you can do there: velvetescape.com/things-to-do...
